runtime: Pure Go. Checked-in tests read SVG/PNG fixtures and require no Python, Cairo, browser, cgo or subprocess renderer.

scope.cascade: Presentation attributes precede author rules; lexicographic (ID,class,type) specificity, then source order; inline declarations override author rules. Inheritance uses computed parent values with inherit, initial, unset and currentColor.
scope.use: Selectors are rematched in each isolated use shadow tree. Host ancestors and uncloned definition ancestors do not participate; styles inherit from the host. Rules inside defs are document-wide. Nested use creates a new boundary.
rejected: CSS variables/functions beyond supported rgb() paint
unknown properties and unsupported values, including unmatched/overridden declarations
scope.existing_render_boundaries: No change to gomath.Style or render. No new viewport clipping or group offscreen compositing. Symbol overflow requiring clipping and non-visible root viewport overflow return errors. Existing group opacity multiplication remains in use.

css-cascade.png.coverage: Cascade, presentation and inline precedence, source order, compounds, selector list, descendant/child selectors, local use instances, symbol viewport placement, stroke styling and antialiased circles.

shadow_semantics.validation: Analytical pixel expectations and computed styles test source/host ancestor isolation, cloned-subtree child matching, inherited colors, nested boundaries, independent IDs/styles and repeat/concurrent imports. Complex shadow-boundary behavior is not inferred from CairoSVG.

benchmark.workload: Each import expands 256 use instances of a two-shape group into 512 vector shapes in a 256x256 SVG user-space viewport. CSS variant adds four selectors, including a child selector, and class/ID matching.
benchmark.image_size: Not applicable for importer benchmark. Separate raster reference is 128x96, one frame.

earlier_development_samples.note: First CSS sample was noisy on the shared development machine; a later final-source measurement is recorded without excluding any samples.
